targets.author: La'Kera
targets.text:
Trade With Me on FOMC day, and y'all, I was logged off before most people finished their coffee ☕

News days are not the days to play hero. FOMC was coming out at 2, so the plan was simple: wait for one clean setup, take it, and get out of the market's way. You're coming along for the whole morning, from the trade idea I send my mentees to journaling the trade after.
